page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin holds short notes, most cut off or faded. Right edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page, which are left out. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: bo nuncupat) erat virorum D c, qui quandiu in vitâ, tandiu in honore hoc manebant. Hos πμέξχος[?] vocabant. Concilio huic præerant viri xv, quorum munus erat negocia obvia & minoris momenti expedire: & his rursum præsidebant tres, qui plurimum poterant. In ordinem Timuchorum nemo allegebatur, cui liberi non essent, cujusve pater, avus, proavus, cives non fuissent. LegLegibus vivebant Ionicis, in publico propositis, ut cognitioni omnium terent[?]. Et quanquam opibus abundabant, tamen in victu & cultu frugalitate & modestiâ gaudebant, erantque rcbastricti[?] moris. Cujus rei argumentum Leg[?]fuisse[?] modum dotis Strabo scribit. Ea maxima erat aureorum centum, insuper in ornatum aureum adjiciebantur aurei quinque, ac totidem in vestem: ultrà non licebat. Qui sanè modus tenuis erat: ex quo conjicere reliqua non est difficile. Id verò etiam frugalitatis argumentum fine dubio erat, quod Ælianus prodidit, non licuisse minaffilienfium[?] fœminis vinum bibere juvenculis nec adultis, sed oportuisse[?] aquæ potu contentas eas esse, quod viverent. Memorabile hoc quoque, quod præter alia de civitate hac scribit minalerius[?], instituta populorum verustis

page.notes: Left margin notes are faded and cut off; only "Leg" is legible with confidence, the others are not read. The right-hand strip is the neighbouring page and is left out. The word after "tenuis" and the Greek word "πμέξχος" are doubtful. The line "Ea maxima" is partly hidden by the left margin. The last line "verustis" continues in the next line, which is not on this page. Bottom left shows faint marks ("min") which are unreadable. "virorum D c" is copied as printed, with its spacing. The running head is at the top centre and the page number at the top left.
